title: TP-doctrine guard: a declared take-profit reached by fewer than 10% of harness trades grades as non-compliant (reach-rate floor 0.10 for near-sentinel TPs)
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14. Source: PI-20261007-SXUZGFME-0001 -- scripts/ci/check_tp_doctrine.py keys entry_state on tp_r >= 50 (sentinel) and the venue cap at a reference ATR, so a finite-but-unreachable TP (e.g. trend_donchian_eth_prop tp_r 6.0 reached by 0.9% of 1,004 harness trades, docs/research/mi307-offline-mfe-2026-09-18.json) passes entry_tp. Build: the guard reads the per-leg MFE/reach-rate evidence and grades reach_rate < 0.10 as non-compliant, with a positive control (a TP reached >= 10% still passes) and the ratchet re-run; counts are re-measured, never quoted. Serves the 'brackets as predictions' milestone. [2026-10-15 lane BRACKETS-AS-PREDICTIONS] BUILT on branch claude/brackets-as-predictions: check_tp_doctrine.py reads mi307's uncapped per-leg reach curve; a declared target with reach < 0.10 grades entry_tp=unreachable; exact-floor passes (positive control), off-grid straddle = unresolved, no evidence = unmeasured (counted, never reachable), unreadable evidence = could-not-look. Ratchet re-run: the 6 prop routings (6R; reach 0.009 eth / 0.019 sol) re-baselined R->ER. Self-test 50/50; pytest 8/8. Closes on merge + the guard on main showing reach_state per routing.
